dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast light perimeters surrounding dark centers. The gradient transitions are abrupt, with perimeters showing jagged, micro-oscillating boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse clusters of small, high-intensity pixel groups lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an irregular quadrangular spatial relationship on the upper flank.
